evidence.quote: Fees and expenses would be paid separately, subject to court approval; any amount not awarded would go to the class.
we can reduce our fee request to $6 million, subject to court approval, if Brightline increases the class fund to $34 million.

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees in the first round, and the parties negotiated fee amounts before agreeing on the class fund. Whitcombe Reyes expressly linked a lower fee request to a higher class fund. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class relief for its own fees, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
